_comment: GEN-003/RELEASE-001: captured live from a real ComfyUI 0.35.0 installation (a CUDA GPU, torch 2.13.0+cu132) via GET /history/{prompt_id} on 2026-09-16. Confirms a real, previously-unmodeled shape: SaveWEBM's history entry carries an 'animated': [true] sibling key next to the real 'images' descriptor list. The synthetic tests/fixtures/outputs/history_video.json fixture never modeled this and _apply_history mis-scanned it as a malformed output, downgrading a fully successful save from 'ready' to 'partial' -- fixed in backend/app/generations/service.py and folded into that synthetic fixture too (see its own updated _comment). This exact graph shape was also submitted through the running application's own UI and correctly reached output_state 'ready' with the produced .webm indexed into the gallery as media_kind 'video' and rendered inline (UI-006). The checkpoint filename is redacted to a placeholder and the prompt_id replaced with a fixture-shaped UUID; everything else, including the real 'animated' key, is exactly what ComfyUI returned.
